## What this site is

The **AI Integration Course** teaches the practical integration tier of AI engineering — how to orchestrate models, chain agents, build context-rich RAG pipelines, connect APIs, automate workflows with low-code tools (n8n, Make, Zapier), and evaluate the business value of AI investments. The emphasis is on production reliability: rate-limit defenses, error fallbacks, context-window management, output validation, and database/vector-store integration — not prompt tips.

**Who it's for**: software engineers, technical founders, operators, and product managers who need working AI automations, plus business leaders evaluating AI strategy. Lessons start from guided, working code; no CS degree is required for the on-ramp tracks.

**Instructor**: Blaine Casey, AI Solutions Architect (https://aiintegrationcourse.com/about).

---

## Curriculum areas

All curriculum links: https://aiintegrationcourse.com/courses

* **The AI Landscape & Opportunities** — structural value capture, technology S-curves, foundation models vs. wrapper applications. For business leaders, strategists, and tech-forward investors.
* **Prompt Engineering & API Orchestration** — structured JSON output, system prompt patterns, few-shot conditioning, tool calling, context window optimization, hallucination mitigation, multi-turn API flows.
* **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) & Vector Search** — embeddings, chunking strategies (recursive, overlap, semantic), vector database storage, similarity scoring, retrieval relevance tuning.
* **Multi-Agent Architectures** — collaborative agent frameworks, message routing, tool-use loops, supervisor patterns, task decomposition, state-machine routing.
* **Low-Code Automation & Enterprise Tooling** — connecting custom agents to n8n, Make, and Zapier; webhooks, API auth handling, event-triggered processes.
* **Investing & Business Strategy in the AI Era** — moats in the AI value chain, hardware vs. middleware vs. application layer, margin analysis of AI-era SaaS.

**Interactive workbench**: every lesson pairs with Allie, a context-aware AI tutor, plus a sandboxed execution environment (the Forge) for running workflow scripts without local setup.

---

## Topics this site covers in depth

1. Building production AI agents and multi-step automations (API-first, not chat-box workflows)
2. RAG implementation: chunking, embeddings, retrieval quality, grounded prompting, evals
3. Multi-agent orchestration, supervisor patterns, and fault-tolerant workflow design
4. AI workflow error handling: retries, fallbacks, idempotency, output validation
5. Persistent AI memory patterns: conversation buffers, semantic memory, entity stores, episodic logs
6. Low-code AI automation with n8n, Make, and Zapier
7. AI tooling comparisons for practitioners (Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini)
8. AI strategy and investment analysis for operators and founders
